headline: Fronts Flare Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition the war’s most violent theatre, Weathered Expanse, has added another 30 ownership changes in the past 24 hours, pushing its toll to 177,638 Colonial and 195,341 Warden dead while casualty rates and enlistments remain on an accelerating curve. Mooring County has erupted with three flips in the last two hours and a 24‑hour tally of 6,145 Colonial and 4,588 Warden casualties, signalling a fresh flashpoint. Farranac Coast continues to churn, recording four flips in the past six hours and a split of one Warden base to nine Colonial, with losses now at 47,335 Colonial and 58,480 Warden. Stonecradle stays hot, logging three flips in the last six hours centred on Buckler Sound and World’s End, casualties climbing to 60,871 Colonial and 77,208 Warden. Linn Mercy remains active with nine flips around Lathair in the last day, totals 54,671 Colonial and 69,042 Warden, and recruitment still rising. Fishermans Row, quiet in the prior report, has surged to fourteen flips in the past 24 hours — Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia and Eidolo the busiest posts — bringing its count to 11,557 Colonial and 13,891 Warden dead. Elsewhere the northern Warden‑held sectors and rear areas show no ownership changes.
